body: MythicMC is a community Minecraft network built around real player freedom. Our SMP runs a player based economy on an open anarchy world (grief allowed, no land claims), our custom Sandbox lets you build with NPCs, dialogue and scripting, and our lobby is packed with crates, unlockable cosmetics, gadgets, seasonal hunts and daily free rewards. Every gamemode has Simple Voice Chat so you can actually talk to people around you. RPG, BedWars and Practice PvP are on the way. Vote daily, climb the ranks, and come build something with us.
